description: Shows the card where the buyer can go ahead with one car on a request. It is for a buyer who said they want to go ahead with this car. An offer can be read without this card through requests_get. It takes the request's `dealSetId` (`id` in requests_list) and the car's `negotiationId` (`rowKey` in requests_get). It does not go ahead for the buyer. Only the buyer does, by tapping Confirm in the card. It answers one `state`: `ok` (the card shows the offer), `choose_on_request_page` (the buyer goes ahead with this car on their request page), `no_offer_yet` (the dealership has not sent an offer, so there is nothing to go ahead with), `not_in_card` (the card cannot offer this car, and the buyer sees where it stands on their request page), `not_found` or `unavailable`. An entry of kind `single` answers choose_on_request_page, or not_in_card when it has ended.

dealSetId.description: The id of the request, from `id` in requests_list.

negotiationId.description: The car the buyer named, from `rowKey` in requests_get.

surface.description: Which card sent this: `offer_card` is the offer card.

name: show_go_ahead_card
title: Show the confirm card
